title: Israeli Draft Law Talks
body: Rav Elya Ber Wachtfogel, South Fallsburg rosh yeshiva, is holding high-level talks with Israeli Gedolei Roshei Yeshiva on the emerging draft-law proposal before presenting it to Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch.

title: Rabbi Chananya Sinai Halberstam
body: Rabbi Chananya Sinai Dovid "Chesed" Halberstam, 74, passed away. Born in Eretz Yisroel, he descended from the illustrious lineage of the Divrei Chaim of Sanz.
